title: Wrong-person first-failure leg guards taken_over_at only at the read layer — a concurrent take-over can still be yanked into the correction loop
evidence: form_handler.gleam: "case row.taken_over_at != "" { True -> wisp.redirect(to: "/reference/" <> token) False -> ... sql.update_reference_call_status(config.db, id_uuid, sql.AwaitingCorrection, "", "contact_invalid", sql.ContactInitiated)"; update_reference_call_status.sql: "WHERE id = $1 / AND status = $5::reference_call_status" (no taken_over_at condition); contrast mark_awaiting_correction.sql:23 "AND taken_over_at IS NULL", exhaust_reference_call.sql:33 "AND taken_over_at IS NULL", find_reference_call_by_send_ref.sql:66 "AND rc.taken_over_at IS NULL"
detail: Every other failure-path writer gained an SQL taken_over_at guard; the wrong-person->awaiting_correction leg checks it only at read. Take-over never changes status, so a take-over landing between the lookup and the status-guarded write still succeeds and the row re-enters the correction loop (A7 invariant, ms-window race, recoverable via correct/substitute).
recommended_fix: Give the wrong-person leg a dedicated guarded transition (mirroring mark_awaiting_correction.sql) with AND taken_over_at IS NULL at the write layer; leave update_reference_call_status unguarded so the §8.6 late-completion path still fires on taken-over rows.

title: Detail-payload negative control is vacuous — the §4.2 form_token containment claim is no longer tested
evidence: "// RC4.3 note: the referee's CONTACT snapshot now legitimately rides the / payload ... the negative control moved to a still-internal marker (form_token is never / selected by the detail read). / string.contains(body, "form_token_internal_sentinel") |> should.be_false"
detail: The old control asserted absence of a real value (larry@example.com); the sentinel string can only appear if a column literally holds it. A regression adding form_token to the detail SELECT (key or token value) would pass the test, so the §4.2 containment claim is now unpinned.
recommended_fix: Assert the form_token KEY is absent (e.g. string.contains(body, "\"form_token\"") should.be_false) or seed a real token value in setup and assert it never rides the detail payload.
